module_summary: Six-state Moore FSM with synchronous-reset state register and case-based next-state table on w, asserting z in states E and F.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 3-bit Moore state register A-F, decoded into output z.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Moore output high in states E or F.

groups.name: fsm
groups.description: State register, next-state table on w, and output decode for z.
